question: What fate follows from fasting by day according to this teaching?
premises: Not eating by day is the means described.
The outcome is expressed as going to death.
The death is qualified as death of age.
inference: By fasting during the day, one will go to death by old age.
uncertainties: The intended sense of vayo mṛtyuṃ gamiṣyate may be idiomatic or elliptical.
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go to death by old age.
